configurations.name: backend
configurations._note: Python 3.11 (pyenv). The venv/ interpreter is Apple's Command Line Tools Python, an app bundle macOS checks for Documents-folder access on its own; launched by the app it is refused and the backend cannot even start. The suite passes on both versions.
